cards.title: MACHINES, EQUIPMENT
cards.text: Comprehensive risk assessment, functional and physical adaptation of machinery parks. We create LOTO procedures, guaranteeing full compliance with directives.

cards.title: OHS
cards.text: Audits, occupational risk assessments, and constant safety supervision. We solve problems comprehensively and build a strong safety culture in production plants.

cards.title: FIRE PROTECTION
cards.text: We develop Fire Safety Instructions (FSI) and evacuation procedures. We ensure prevention and full compliance with the strict requirements of the State Fire Service.

cards.title: ADR
cards.text: Professional consultancy in the transport of dangerous goods. We support you in documentation, handling, and the safe organisation of logistics processes.

cards.title: ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
cards.text: We monitor the enterprise's continuous impact on the surroundings. We assist in implementing environmental procedures, reporting, and maintaining compliance with legal requirements.

cards.title: PARTS MACHINING
cards.text: Maintenance support in optimising technological processes. We ensure the highest standards of safety and precision in mechanical processing.

cards.title: Physical Working Environment MEASUREMENTS
cards.text: Accurate electrical measurements, quality testing, and thermal imaging. We diagnose conditions at workstations to instantly eliminate hidden risks.

cards.title: OCCUPATIONAL MEDICINE
cards.text: Comprehensive preventive employee healthcare. Efficient organisation of medical examinations, ensuring safety and health compliance without unnecessary facility downtime.

cards.title: EMPLOYMENT AGENCY
cards.text: Dedicated training and efficient onboarding, including support for foreigners. We provide personnel to quickly and safely integrate new staff into the workplace.

cards.title: ISO
cards.text: Implementation, maintenance, and auditing of management systems. We help prepare for certification, minimising bureaucracy and saving time on formalities.

stages.name: Pathological Culture
stages.text: Safety is not important. We only do the bare minimum to avoid getting caught.
stages.management: Management doesn't know and doesn't want to know.

stages.name: Reactive Culture
stages.text: We react only when an accident occurs or during an inspection.
stages.management: Management knows, but shows no initiative.

stages.name: Compliance Culture
stages.text: Regulatory compliance is important. We have risk management systems in place.
stages.management: Management cares, but doesn't always know how to act.

stages.name: Proactive Culture
stages.text: Continuous improvement is key. Everyone is involved in OHS.
stages.management: Management cares and knows how to improve the system.

stages.name: Mature Culture
stages.text: OHS is our priority. It is built into our DNA and business development.
stages.management: Management monitors, measures, and genuinely leads.

noBlame.headline: No-Blame Culture
phrases: Let's focus on the next step.
What can we learn from this?
We will get through this as a team.
Next time we will try this approach.
We are here to support each other.
We learn more from mistakes than from successes.
